أستعطف (form X)
# أَسْتَعْطِفُ (ʔastaʕṭifu) /ʔas.taʕ.tˤi.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
# أُسْتَعْطَفُ (ʔustaʕṭafu) /ʔus.taʕ.tˤa.fu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
# أَسْتَعْطِفَ (ʔastaʕṭifa) /ʔas.taʕ.tˤi.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
# أُسْتَعْطَف
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
